newsitem.title: USA: Playtex Products to build new facility.
newsitem.headline: Playtex Products to build new facility.

text.p: Playtex Products Inc said it is building a new 43,000 square foot research and development center in Allendale, N.J.
The company said it expects construction to be completed in March, 1998.
"This project clearly indicates the company's commitment to new products as a major source of our growth," said Michael Gallagher, chief executive.

"This will be a state of the art facility, providing the resources and space needed for our staff of scientists, engineers and consumer affairs specialists to develop innovative new products and line extensions."
Construction for the new center should begin in August, Playtex said.
